verdict.rationale: Fin documents its own escalation configuration: a help article titled "Manage Fin AI Agent's escalation guidance and rules", direct transfer to agents in the preferred inbox, and a preview "Escalate to a human" API endpoint. The pack has only titles and short snippets, so the specific trigger types and reliable compliance cannot be confirmed. missing for 10: documented rule criteria for topic, sentiment, customer tier and explicit customer request; evidence that Fin reliably obeys the rules; independent or hands-on corroboration; GA status of the escalate endpoint (preview only).
